description: Dybdedata i Oslofjorden - terrengmodell - 1-m-grid is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Norges geologiske undersøkelse. Dybdemodellen er et regulært batymetri-grid for indre Oslofjord med 1m-oppløsning. Grunnlaget for datasettet er detaljerte dybdedata innsamlet ved bruk av interferometrisk sonar og multistråleekkolodd. Coverage: indre Oslofjord. The publisher named on the listing is Norges geologiske undersøkelse. Its keywords include Bærum, Nesodden, Natur, Relieff, Terreng, Geology. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOTIFF. The listing shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
